headline: Steam Winter Sale 2026 starts December 17
title: Steam Winter Sale 2026 | Starts December 17 | Gaming News
video_script: Valve's Steam Winter Sale twenty twenty six is scheduled to start on December seventeenth and run until January fourth, twenty twenty seven. That is about eighteen days of discounts. Before it, Steam also has an Auto Battler RPG Fest from November sixteenth to November twenty third. Valve plans Black Friday discounts too, but has not announced dates. What is on your wishlist? Comment below!
description: Steam Winter Sale 2026 is scheduled for December 17, 2026 to January 4, 2027, per Valve's published events schedule. Sources: GamingOnLinux, Windows Report.
joke: Your wishlist is long, your backlog is longer, and the sale does not care.
